On Sunday, Spotify teamed up with Live Nation Urban for RNB X Live, our first-ever


[standalone R&B festival](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2026-09-08/rnbx-live-festival-dallas/) . The event brought Spotify’s flagship R&B playlist


[RNB X](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX4SBhb3fqCJd) to life at The Pavilion at Toyota Music Factory in Dallas, celebrating the genre’s legacy alongside the next generation of artists shaping it.


The lineup included hometown icon


[Erykah Badu](https://open.spotify.com/artist/7IfculRW2WXyzNQ8djX8WX) , R&B powerhouse


[H.E.R.](https://open.spotify.com/artist/3Y7RZ31TRPVadSFVy1o8os) , and Dallas native


[rjtheweirdo](https://open.spotify.com/artist/5XWVWbQiBVEEXZSFyEsUcW) , who opened the night.


[DESTIN CONRAD](https://open.spotify.com/artist/4jwROPSUkTkohLCRiyjiZZ) ,


[kwn](https://open.spotify.com/artist/2KnhnL8zuqLhIhGk601fsb) , and


[Jai’len Josey](https://open.spotify.com/artist/1BAN8UUSAMDeNfP1Wo5WWr) also took the stage, building on Spotify’s support for emerging talent through programs like


[Artists To Watch](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX3I51YwwOUVo) and


[Fresh Finds](https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DWWjGdmeTyeJ6) .


Destin Conrad (Photo by Rick Kern/Getty Images for Spotify)


(Photo by Rick Kern/Getty Images for Spotify)

NEXT


Fans heard songs like Erykah Badu’s “


[On & On](https://open.spotify.com/track/0tNuJpBgtE65diL6Q8Q7fI) ,” H.E.R.’s “


[Could’ve Been](https://open.spotify.com/album/31UbtEgSCnXhwUMIEP4G9q) ,” kwn’s “


[do what i say](https://open.spotify.com/track/2TYAJJTyGC4i3m0RlhuXeu) ,” and Destin Conrad’s “


[KISSING IN PUBLIC](https://open.spotify.com/track/2tA9LObXZkn5oazvqyRkxY) ,” along with surprise appearances from


[Miles Caton](https://open.spotify.com/artist/0EEwD5PTnNLxUfAS22mErL) during H.E.R.’s set and


[The Alchemist](https://open.spotify.com/artist/0eVyjRhzZKke2KFYTcDkeu) alongside Badu.


Marking H.E.R.’s highly anticipated return to the stage, fans heard two unreleased songs for the first time, “Did You Miss Me” and “Friends.” Destin Conrad also rejoined kwn onstage to perform their collaborations, “


[all fours](https://open.spotify.com/track/4swgjjK6EDlUjjtRZrDaFI) ” and “


[DADAMAN](https://open.spotify.com/track/5O9aVGryqU0Um5l4a1pezL) .”


Beyond the performances, Premium subscribers in attendance received special merch created in collaboration with Curves by Sean Brown.


The Dallas festival marked our biggest RNB X live event to date, building on earlier experiences including


[RNB X After Hours](https://www.instagram.com/p/DCXvRzDSjSy/) in Washington, D.C., and


[RNB X Live: The UK Sound](https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-07-31/live-nation-urban-and-spotify-bring-emerging-uk-rb-talent-to-the-us-with-rnb-x-live-the-uk-sound/) in New York and San Francisco.


Fans can keep the music going after the festival, too. Select performances from the concert were captured for exclusive release on Spotify, giving fans a chance to revisit highlights from the night.


*Dive into RNB X on Spotify to discover your next favorite R&B artist.*
